\label{lesson:KA-C250-sutta}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for opposite, then the Kannada for a district.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಸುತ್ತ}}
\textbf{\kn{ಸುತ್ತ}} — \emph{sutta} — \textquotedblleft{}around\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ಸುತ್ತ}} (\emph{sutta}) is native Dravidian, from \emph{suttu}, \textquotedblleft{}to surround, go round\textquotedblright{}, which DEDR 2715 lists; the entry also has Tamil \emph{cuṟṟu} and Telugu \emph{cuṭṭu}.
\end{cousinweb}
